items_all.summary: Following a post on X, AMD Japan's claim that the company values gamers "above all else" saw those gamers point out that its own CEO believes the company is more focused on data centers.

items_all.summary: Nvidia’s GeForce 621.14 and 621.24 drivers reportedly rewrite a log file nonstop, writing gigabytes to SSDs every hour.

items_all.summary: Interim CEO Collete Kress reportedly offered staffers higher wages and more equity on an advanced schedule at the company's first all-hands after Jensen Huang resigned.

items_all.title: GTA VI runs at 1440p on PS5 and Xbox Series X, but just 720p with upscaling on Series S
items_all.summary: GTA VI will target 30FPS across PlayStation and Xbox consoles, with Rockstar using its own temporal anti-aliasing solution on the PS5 and Xbox Series X, Sony's PSSR 2 on the PS5 Pro, and AMD's FSR 4 on the Xbox Series S.

Leaked Ohio bill could allow AI data center companies to seize private land for their buildouts using eminent domain law
items_all.summary: A leaked Ohio bill could allow data centers to qualify as public utilities for the purpose of eminent domain law, allowing companies to seize private land for building new facilities.

items_all.title: Nvidia says it’s ‘absurd’ to assume it predicted the agentic moment during Vera’s development
items_all.summary: AMD has criticized Nvidia, and to a lesser extent Arm, for claims about creating a CPU designed for agentic AI. Nvidia is pushing back on that characterization, instead saying Vera was designed with “base principles, product intuition, and oftentimes simple allegorical laws of computer science” in a recent interview with Tom’s Hardware.

items_all.title: Elon Musk’s SpaceXAI suffers chemical spill at Mississippi AI data center
items_all.summary: 5,000 to 6,000 gallons of propylene glycol spilled from a SpaceXAI facility in Southaven, Mississippi, before reaching a nearby drainage ditch. State environmental officials have sought to ease the worries of locals, saying there is no risk to their health.

items_all.title: The Downfall of Jensen Huang — a timeline of allegations and scandals that brought down the king of AI infrastructure
items_all.summary: Jensen’s affairs dominated headlines, but the seeds of his downfall were planted in both the bedroom and the boardroom and stretched from Beijing to Washington, with Nvidia sitting right in the middle.

items_all.summary: A TrendForce report reveals that gamers are buying OLED monitors in a big way, and ASUS leads the pack.

items_all.title: Nvidia board faction angling for Jensen Huang return as CEO, report claims
items_all.summary: Despite Nvidia's board saying it has no intention of bringing former CEO Jensen Huang back to the company, some directors are reportedly still pushing for that to happen.

items_all.title: Nvidia's revenue hits $115.8 billion as Vera Rubin generates $20 billion in another record-setting quarter
items_all.summary: Nvidia's quarterly revenue surged to $115.8 billion as Vera Rubin achieved a record $20 billion debut, while total commitments to suppliers and customers climbed to $540 billion and rising costs prompted a revised pricing strategy for FY2028.

items_all.title: SSDs, laptops, and phones may get cheaper as consumer NAND spot pricing drops 20%
items_all.summary: According to a new report, slowing demand for consumer electronics and diverging production requirements for consumer and enterprise NAND have resulted in declining spot prices for consumer-grade flash memory. Those trends may result in unexpected but welcome relief for consumers.

items_all.title: $3.26 million in SpaceX AI data center revenue will be pumped back into the City of Memphis
items_all.summary: The City of Memphis is making its first major investment, almost $3.3 million, through the Community Benefit Ordinance. The fund was set up to use a portion of the tax generated by SpaceX AI's Colossus 1 facility for the benefit of residents, with the first $2 million allocated for a new home repair assistance program.
